notes:
Changes since the public 0.1.0-beta.1 release.

### Added

- Native MCP authoring across all eight document types, with approved local workspace access, revision checks, recoverable save points, and HTTP or bundled stdio connections.
- Agent image uploads, activity feedback, and document previews.
- Available-model selection after validating OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini credentials; API keys stored in the operating system credential vault.
- Yellow text highlighting and anchored offline comment threads, including replies, resolution, navigation, and document persistence.
- Settings → Updates, with fixed beta/stable channels, signed update verification, release notes, download progress, and user-controlled installation.

### Fixed

- macOS chapter-title clipping, draft Find shortcuts, native File/Edit menu actions, and platform-specific shortcut labels.
- Wrapping email subjects, pane-sized screenplay previews, and readable mode labels and sidebar document actions in narrow windows.
- Sidebar navigation keeps document creation and utilities reachable in short windows.
- Visual/Audio board columns keep their configured widths, with mouse-accessible scroll controls and reference-image fields contained inside each cell.
- Saved writing-mode conversions retain their layout when reopened.
- Discard Changes keyboard routing and cleanup of intentionally discarded recovery drafts.
- Windows installer helper replacement paths render correctly, with clean-install and locked-helper checks against the actual installer template.
- Startup with an unconfigured updater in local builds.
- Release bundling receives the same updater verification key as the app, and package checks reject Mac apps or helpers missing Intel or Apple Silicon support.
- macOS release packaging accepts App Store Connect API-key notarization alongside Apple ID credentials, with temporary CI keys removed after bundling.
- Embedded-image stability while clicking, selecting, and editing manuscript text.
- Save and autosave coordination, revision checking, and recovery behavior.
- Persistence of approved local workspace access across restarts.
- Taller social-post caption fields and MCP upload schema compatibility.

### Release safeguards

- Stela Cloud is unavailable in this release. Local authoring, BYOK, and local MCP remain available; cached Cloud records are retained.
- Install preparation protects unsaved writing, unfinished comments, uploads, and active agent operations. A running MCP helper prompts for disconnect and retry.
- Beta and stable release pipelines verify both Windows and universal macOS before publishing; production builds exclude local environment files and undergo credential scans.
- Local beta releases keep signing credentials on the release Mac, verify Windows build provenance and payload digests, and publish immutable packages before advancing the update feed.

### Installation notes

- Install this version manually once when upgrading from beta.1–beta.6; those builds do not include the updater.
- Beta builds receive beta updates only. Stable builds receive stable updates only. Install the other channel manually to switch.
- Windows beta installers may be unsigned and show a publisher warning. Update payloads always require cryptographic signatures. macOS releases require signing and notarization.
- Automatic checks do not download, install, or restart without your action. Save untitled writing and post or discard unfinished comments before installation.
